answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock collateral at the kernel of its identity before it can act, so minting a new persona costs real capital. Sybils no longer scale for free. Model the network as a graph and weight trust by each vertex, slashing stake when peers detect collusion. Like a lotus rooted in mud, honest reputation grows slowly from proof of staked work, making fake-identity swarms economically irrational.
